name: humanize
description: Strip AI-writing tells and make prose clearer and more concise. Use when editing or reviewing text to sound natural and human, or when writing any prose humans will read: documentation, commit messages, pull request descriptions, error messages, UI copy, help text, comments, reports, explanations. Fixes AI patterns (inflated significance, promotional language, -ing analyses, vague attributions, em dashes, rule of three, AI vocabulary, passive voice, negative parallelisms, filler) and applies Strunk's Elements of Style (active voice, positive form, concrete language, needless words, parallel construction).
